text: Pointer copies, casts, arithmetic, comparisons, and space mappings shall not initialize storage, extend lifetime, change underlying mutability, or increase permissions. Address-only pointers shall permit only contract-defined copy/comparison/conversion, not arithmetic, field selection, or access.
